text.body: śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrīmahādeva uvācaḥ | namo'stu rāmāya saśaktikāya nīlotpalaśyāmalakomalāya | kirīṭahārāṅgadabhūṣaṇāya siṃhāsanasthāya mahāprabhāya || 1|| tvamādimadhyāntavihīna ekaḥ sṛjasyavasyatsi ca lokajātam | svamāyayā tena na lipyase tvaṃ yatsve mukhe'jasrarato'navadyaḥ || 2|| līlāṃ vidhatse guṇasaṃvṛtastvaṃ prapannabhaktānuvidhānahetoḥ | nānāvatāraiḥ suramānuṣādyaiḥ pratīyase jñānibhireva nityam || 3|| svāṃśena lokaṃ sakalaṃ vidhāya taṃ bibharṣi ca tvaṃ tadadhaḥ phaṇīśvaraḥ | uparyadho bhānvaniloḍupauṣadhīpravarṣarūpo'vasi naikadhā jagat || 4|| tvamiha dehabhṛtāṃ śikhirūpaḥ pacasi bhaktamaśeṣamajasram | pavanamañcakarūpasahāyo jagadakhaṇḍamanena bibharṣi || 5|| candrasūryaśikhimadhyagataṃ yatteja īśa cidaśeṣatanūnām | prābhavattanubhṛtāmiha dhairyaṃ śauryamātramakhilaṃ tava sattvam || 6|| tvaṃ viriñciśivaviṣṇuvibhedāt kālakarmaśaśisūryavibhāgāt | vādināṃ pṛthagiveśa bibhāsi brahma niścitamananyadihaikam || 7|| matsyādirūpeṇa yathā tvamekaḥ śruto purāṇeṣu ca lokasiddhaḥ | tathaiva sarvaṃ sadayadvibhāgastvameva nānyadbhavato vibhāti || 8|| yadyatsamutpannamanantasṛṣṭāvutpatsyate yacca bhavacca yacca | na dṛśyate sthāvarajaṅgamādau tvayā vinā'taḥ parataḥ parastvam || 9|| tatvaṃ na jānanti parātmanaste janaḥ samastāstava māyayā'taḥ | tvadbhaktasevāmalamānasānāṃ vibhāti tatvaṃ paramekamaiśam || 10|| brahmādayaste na viduḥ svarūpaṃ cidātmatatvaṃ bahirarthabhāvāḥ | tato budhastvāmidameva rūpaṃ bhaktyā bhajanmuktimupaityaduḥkhaḥ || 11|| ahaṃ bhavannāmaguṇaiḥ kṛtārtho vasāmi kāśyāmaniśaṃ bhavānyā | mumūrṣamāṇasya vimuktaye'haṃ diśāmi mantraṃ tava rāmanāma || 12|| imaṃ stavaṃ nityamananyabhaktyā śrṛṇvanti gāyanti likhanti ye vai | te sarvasaukhyaṃ paramaṃ ca labdhā bhavatpadaṃ yāntu bhavatprasādāt || 13|| || iti śrīmadadhyātmarāmāyaṇe śrīmahādevakṛtaṃ rāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam ||
